# GET /api/v1/user/actions/runners/{runner_id}

Get a specific user-level action runner by ID

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-177`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| runner_id | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — ActionRunner

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Runner ID |
| `name` | string | Runner name |
| `status` | string | online or offline |
| `busy` | bool | Whether runner is actively running a job |
| `disabled` | bool | Whether runner is disabled |
| `ephemeral` | bool | Whether runner is ephemeral |
| `labels` | []*ActionRunnerLabel | Runner labels |

- **400** — Invalid runner_id
- **404** — Runner not found or not editable in user context

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.GetRunner | controller | Extract runner_id from path, pass ownerID=ctx.Doer.ID, repoID=0 |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | shared.GetRunner | service | Call getRunnerByID to fetch and validate ownership; Convert to API type |
| 3 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | shared.getRunnerByID | service | Fetch runner by ID from DB; Check EditableInContext(ownerID, repoID) |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Runner must be editable in user context - runner's OwnerID must match the authenticated user's ID | authorization | ownerID > 0 && r.OwnerID == ownerID |
| ownerID and repoID must not both be non-zero - panics in dev/testing mode | validation | ownerID != 0 && repoID != 0 |

| Runner ID not found in DB | 404 | Runner not found | False |
| Runner belongs to different owner | 404 | No permission to access this runner | False |
